answer:
The 1967 Federation Cup is an instance of the **Federation Cup** tournament, which is named after the **International Tennis Federation (ITF)**. 

The ITF launched the Federation Cup in 1963 to celebrate its 50th anniversary. The tournament was later renamed the Billie Jean King Cup in 2020.
